description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

**Do**

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc

.

title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.
  
  
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
  
  
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
  
  
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
  
  
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
  
  
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Product development and technical ownership**

* Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
* Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
* Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
* Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
* Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

**Investigation, performance, and quality**

* Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes.
* Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components.
* Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads.
* Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks.
* Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks.
* Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces.

**Engineering execution and collaboration**

* Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance.
* Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones.
* Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives.
* Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability.
* Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team.
* Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems.
* As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality.

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful.
* Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
